newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU opens special tender for Azerbaijan flour.
newsitem.headline: EU opens special tender for Azerbaijan flour.

text.p: The European Commission has opened a special tender for 6,000 tonnes of free wheat flour for Azerbaijan, it said in a notice in the European Union's Official Journal on Thursday.
Two intended shipments of 3,000 tonnes each have been opened as one tender because of the political situation in the country and transport difficulties involved the notice said. The two
lots of 3,000 tonnes of flour will be made available at the port of Antwerp for loading within a maximum of 10 days with effect from February 17. The regulation will enter into force three
day's after publication of the notice.
